feature: Add Bulk Status Change for Production Orders
workflow_rationale: This is a simple workflow because it: 1) Involves only a single service (Django app), 2) Extends an existing, well-established pattern (bin batch operations), 3) Has clear, straightforward requirements with no architectural decisions needed, 4) Low risk - adds new endpoints without modifying existing functionality

phases.name: Bulk Operations Implementation
phases.description: Add bulk start and complete operations following the bin_batch pattern

key_requirements: Accept list of order_ids from POST request (getlist('order_ids[]') or JSON)
Validate at least one order selected
Use transaction.atomic() to wrap the operation
Loop through order_ids, call order.start(request.user) for each
Track successes and failures with detailed error messages
Return JsonResponse with counts: {success: true, started: N, failed: N, errors: [...]}

subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented production_order_batch_start view function following bin_batch_create pattern. Includes JSON/POST data support, transaction.atomic() for atomicity, detailed error tracking, and proper validation. URL route added for testing. Syntax validation passed.

implementation_details.pattern_to_follow: Same as batch_start but calling order.complete()
key_requirements: Accept list of order_ids from POST request
Validate at least one order selected
Use transaction.atomic() to wrap the operation
Loop through order_ids, call order.complete(request.user) for each

subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented production_order_batch_complete view function following the pattern from production_order_batch_start and bin_batch_create. Includes JSON/POST data support, transaction.atomic() for atomicity, detailed error tracking with success/failure counts, and proper validation (not empty, max 100 orders). URL route added to apps/production/urls.py. Syntax validation passed for both views.py and urls.py.

subtasks.description: Add URL patterns for bulk operations

verification.expected: Both URLs appear in route list

subtasks.notes: URL patterns for bulk operations were already added in previous subtasks (subtask-1-1 and subtask-1-2). Verified that both URLs are present in apps/production/urls.py at lines 16-17: 'orders/batch-start/' and 'orders/batch-complete/'. URLs follow the bin batch pattern correctly and are properly positioned after order_complete URL. Changes were already committed in commits 21e1784 and 02627a7.

subtasks.description: Add checkbox selection UI to production order list

changes_required: Add checkbox column to table header with 'Select All' checkbox
Add checkbox to each row in tbody that calls toggleOrderSelection
Add bulk action buttons above table (Start Selected, Complete Selected)
Show/hide bulk buttons based on selectedOrders.length > 0
Add visual feedback when orders are selected (e.g., highlight row)
implementation_details.ui_location: Add bulk action buttons in card-header next to 'Ordens de Producao' title

checks: Checkboxes appear in each table row
Bulk action buttons appear when orders selected

subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented checkbox selection UI for production order list. Added bulk action bar, select all functionality, individual checkboxes for each row, and Alpine.js selection management functions. All verification criteria met.

subtasks.description: Add bulk operation methods to Alpine.js orderManager

implementation_details.location: In orderManager() function in extra_js block
methods_to_add: bulkStartOrders() - POST selectedOrders to batch-start endpoint
bulkCompleteOrders() - POST selectedOrders to batch-complete endpoint
key_requirements: Show confirmation modal before bulk action
Show results (N started, M failed) after completion
Clear selection and reload page on success
Handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages

subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented bulk operation methods in Alpine.js orderManager. Added bulkStatusModalOpen state, isBulkOperation flag, bulkStartOrders() and bulkCompleteOrders() methods, executeBulkAction() for batch API calls, bulk status change modal, and updated confirmation modal to handle bulk operations. Implementation follows the bin_list.html binManager pattern with proper error handling, success messages showing counts, and selection clearing after successful operations.

acceptance_criteria: Bulk start endpoint accepts multiple order IDs and starts valid orders
Bulk complete endpoint accepts multiple order IDs and completes valid orders
UI allows selecting multiple orders via checkboxes
Bulk action buttons appear only when orders are selected
Operations wrapped in transaction.atomic() for atomicity
Detailed success/failure reporting returned to user
Invalid status transitions are handled gracefully with error messages
Existing single-order operations continue to work unchanged

verification_steps.name: Manual UI Testing
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All UI interactions work as expected
instructions: Confirm action and verify orders change to IN_PROGRESS
Test bulk action with mixed statuses (some valid, some invalid)

verification_steps.name: API Endpoint Testing
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Endpoints return correct status codes and JSON structure
instructions: Create 3 test production orders with PLANNED status
Verify response includes success: true, started: 3, failed: 0
Verify orders changed to IN_PROGRESS status
Verify response includes success: true, completed: 3, failed: 0
Test with orders in wrong status

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk because: 1) Adds new endpoints without modifying existing ones, 2) Follows well-established pattern from bin batch operations, 3) Uses existing model methods (start/complete), 4) Transaction.atomic() ensures data consistency. Manual testing is sufficient given the straightforward nature and visual UI component.

unit_tests.reasoning: Simple feature extension - manual testing sufficient
